name: breaker_ds2_detect_bypass
description: Detect blindspots: lowercase PAN, slash/paren phones & STD landlines, invalid-checksum synthetic Aadhaar, unseen headers/keys, URL-encoded PII, Cyrillic homoglyphs

attacks.fails_because: aegis/detect/ids.py:20 compiles PAN = [A-Z]{5}\d{4}[A-Z] without re.I, causing lowercase/mixed-case PANs to bypass unlabelled PAN detection.

attacks.attack: Slash-separated phones, parenthesized mobiles, STD landlines behind unseen labels (caller=, dial:, helpline#)
attacks.fails_because: ids.py:25-30 _PHONE_BODY lacks '/' and '(xxx) xxx-xxxx' patterns and STD landlines; ids.py:59 _LABELLED omits caller/dial/helpline#/emergency_num.

attacks.attack: Mixed-separator Aadhaar, leading-1 Aadhaar, numeric-only MRN + unseen Hindi headers (pehchaan_sankhya, parchi_no, dak_code, rogee_vyakti)
attacks.fails_because: ids.py:19 AADHAAR backreference \1 rejects '4567-8901 2345', [2-9] rejects '1234...', MRN_SHAPES rejects pure digits without known MRN header.

attacks.attack: Patient names placed as JSON object keys under 'escalation_map' and 'ward_assignments'
attacks.fails_because: aegis/detect/engine.py restricts JSON-key name extraction to specific parent patterns (like 'by_*'), missing names inside arbitrary maps.

attacks.attack: URL-encoded path (%5C/_), Cyrillic lookalike characters in name, and same-name Dr./Patient homonym with medical eponyms
attacks.fails_because: %5C delimiters fuse path tokens preventing name match; Cyrillic U+0430 breaks Latin dictionaries/tokenizers; Dr./patient homonym risks either leaking patient or redacting clinician.

attacks.attack: Devanagari slash-phone digits + unseen column headers + doctor column with <50% Dr. prefixes (1 of 3)
attacks.fails_because: Devanagari slash-phone bypasses PHONE patterns; PR #8 doctor-column heuristic checks if >50% of names appear with 'Dr.' elsewhere, misclassifying unprefixed clinicians.
